findings.explanation: Payment is due 90 days after invoicing, which significantly delays your cash flow.
You must wait 90 days to receive payment after invoicing, which creates a significant cash flow burden for your business.
findings.suggested_change: The Client shall pay all approved invoices within 30 days of receipt.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. Thank you for sharing the agreement. Before we proceed, I would like to propose the following adjustments: - Regarding the relevant clause stating "Invoices are payable Net 90.", payment is due 90 days after invoicing, which significantly delays cash flow, so I propose changing this to "Invoices are payable Net 30." - Regarding the relevant clause stating "Payment period: Net 90", waiting 90 days to receive payment creates a significant cash flow burden, so I propose changing this to "The Client shall pay all approved invoices within 30 days of receipt." Please let me know if these changes are acceptable. Best regards,
